_notes: Four placeholder pneumatic / electric linear pushers spanning short-stroke light-duty through long-stroke heavy-duty. Vendor data is intentionally generic — no specific catalog was traced. Replace with real datasheets (Festo, SMC, Bosch Rexroth) before any engineering decision relies on these numbers.
Footprints are rectangular base plates approximated from photos of typical pneumatic stations; the cylinder body sits inside a footprint that also includes the mounting flange.
cycle_time_per_push_s is the round-trip time for ONE box transfer (extend + retract + dwell). For palletizing it bounds the per-box rate.
stroke_m is the actuator's maximum linear travel. For palletizing this gates how deep into the pallet a box can be pushed.
Prices, power figures, and lifetimes are rough engineering estimates so the enumerator has comparable cost numbers; refine before use.
